To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the interfacial reaction between the Ni UBM and the Sn containing solders during reflow is Ni3Sn4 and a P-rich layer.
the P-rich layer was formed at the Ni3-Sn4 IMC and the growth of P-rich layer can be controlled by the processing condition.
the interfacial reaction between the electroless Ni-P UBM and the Sn containing solder is Ni3Sn4 and P-rich Ni.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the optimization of the electroless Ni P UBM layer for flip chip solder joints, and the interfacial reactions between the electroless Ni and Sn containing solder bumps were investigated.
the effects of the P-rich layer, Ni3Sn4 intermetallic compound and the Kirkendell voids on flip chip solder joints reliability.
the optimization of the electroless Ni-P UBM layer for flip chip solder joint application.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the formation of the IMC layer and the Kirkendell voids at the Ni UBM-Solder interface, and the P-rich layer at the Ni UMB-Sn interface are the major causes of the poor bump adhesion strength and the brittle failure of the flip chip solder joint.
a P-rich Ni interlayer is formed at the Ni3Snterface and it is a major contributor to the degradation of the adhesion strength.
the electroless Ni-P UBM is not suitable for Sn containing solders because of the Kirkendall effect and the formation of the brittle P-rich Ni layer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
electroless Ni UMBM is a good candidate for flip chip bumping applications.
the electroless Ni-P UBM is not suitable for flip-chip solder joints with a high P content in the Ni-P film.
the electroless Ni-Sn IMCs and P-rich Ni layers are formed during solder reflow.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a P-rich Ni film is formed during solder reflow at the interface between the Ni-SnP IMC and electroless Ni UMB layer.
the electroless Ni-P UBM layer is not suitable for flip chip solder joints with Sn containing solders because of the formation of the P-rich layer.
the P-rich layer is not a good candidate for UBM.
